changeSet.comment: Test data for addresses from hotel schema
changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO hotel.addresses (street, house_number, country_id, city_id, created_at) SELECT CASE WHEN random() < 0.5 THEN 'Zhilunovicha' ELSE 'Polessia' END AS street, CONCAT(gs, 'a') AS house_number, gs AS country_id, gs AS city_id, NOW() AT TIME ZONE 'utc' FROM generate_series(1, 20) AS gs;
